# PROVENANCE — gse-intelligence-build / coaching / data / README.md
# Data dictionary for the coaching tendency engine tables.
# Generated by coaching/build/build_tables.py from the base pipeline's
# pbp_2022..2026.parquet (nflverse). Rebuild: see build_tables.py header.
# Research basis: corpus-intelligence/deep/c03/buildable-systems.md (M01–M12).

# Coaching data tables

All tables are plain CSV. Empty field = missing/undefined (never zero-filled).
Seasons 2022–2025 are full (incl. playoffs where present in the source files);
2026 covers weeks 1–3 only (8,311 plays as of 2026-10-02).

Shared filters (coaching/common.py — the single source of truth):
- **scrimmage play**: play_type in (pass, run), not qb_kneel/qb_spike/aborted, posteam not null
- **neutral script**: 0.35 <= wp <= 0.65
- **early down**: down in (1, 2); **distance bins**: short (<=3), mid (4–7), long (8+)
- **pass rate**: pass_attempt / (pass_attempt + rush_attempt)
- **quick-game rate**: share of pass attempts with air_yards <= 5 (nflverse proxy; TTT is charting-gapped)

## Tables

**pass_rate_cells.csv** — (season, team, down_group, ydstogo_bin): n_pass, n_rush, n_plays.
LOYO input for PROE. down_group in (early, third, fourth).

**proe_early_neutral.csv** — (season, team): M01 Pass Rate Over Expected.
- pass_rate_actual: neutral-script early-down pass rate
- pass_rate_expected: plays-weighted LOYO cell expectation (team excluded from its own cells)
- proe_raw: actual − expected
- proe: EB-shrunk toward 0, k = 290 (league-median neutral-early-down n, 2022–2026)
- proe_se: binomial SE of the actual rate
- publishable: n_plays >= 25 (1575's publication gate, enforced mechanically)

**weekly_tendencies.csv** — (season, week, team): n_plays, early_down_pass_rate,
shotgun_rate, no_huddle_rate, quick_game_rate, avg_air_yards, pass_rate_all.
Feed for the M04 regime gate and M10 adjustment quantifier.

**sequencing.csv** — (season, team, down in (2,3)): M08 first-order contrast.
n_pairs; p_pass_after_succ_run / p_pass_after_fail_run where the previous play
(same game+drive, immediately preceding scrimmage play) was a run and success
= epa > 0; contrast = difference; contrast_se = two-sample SE.

**script_elasticity.csv** — (season, team): M06 beta_script = plays-weighted OLS
slope of early-down pass rate on WP bin center (10 bins); NaN when <4 non-empty
bins. Negative = normal (runs more when ahead); ~0 = game-state independent.

**rz_mix.csv** — (season, team): M05 red-zone (yardline_100 <= 20) mix.
rz_pass_rate; rz_proe = RZ PROE over (season, down, ydstogo_bin) RZ cells,
EB k=60; rz_proe_se; gtg_pass_rate + n_gtg_plays (goal-to-go, yardline_100 <= 10).

**second_and_short.csv** — (season, team, situation): 2n1 (2nd & exactly 1) and
2n_short (2nd & <=3) pass rates. Filter: ALL scrimmage plays — the published
"normal situations" filter behind the 2025 20.6% anchor is unrecoverable (five
reasonable variants land 26–29%), so this table reports the computed value with
its filter documented instead of the anchor. 2026 level (32.7%) and YoY
direction reproduce.

**tempo.csv** — (season, team): M09 pace_p25/pace_med/pace_p75 = seconds between
consecutive offensive plays in the same drive, 4–120s filter (identical to the
base pipeline); hurryup_rate = no-huddle share when wp < 0.35, <300s left, qtr
in (2,4); n_diffs.

**adjustments.csv** — (season, team, week): M10 Mahalanobis (diagonal-covariance)
distance of the week's [quick_game_rate, avg_air_yards/10, shotgun_rate,
early_down_pass_rate, no_huddle_rate] vector vs the season-to-date baseline;
pct_rank within season; delta_json per-component deltas. context_note flags the
OL-injury / opp-pass-rush tags as nullable until the OL lane lands.

**dc_pressure.csv** — (season, team, down, dist_bin): M11 pressure_proxy =
(sacks + qb_hits) / dropbacks; n_dropbacks; proxy_label is ALWAYS
'outcome-not-frequency' — what the defense achieved, not how often it blitzed.
tfl_rate_vs_rush_proxy is reserved (empty until sourced).

**timeouts.csv** — (season, team): M12 timeouts_per_game; share_before_2mw
(before = not (qtr in (2,4) and <=120s left)); n_games. challenge_note records
that challenge fields are absent from nflverse pbp — nothing is emitted for them.

**schedule.csv** — (season, week, team): opponent. Built by
`coaching/build/build_pressure_answer.py` from game_id (2022–2026).

**def_pressure_weekly.csv** — (season, week, team): defensive pressure proxy.
db = dropbacks faced; pressures = sacks + qb_hits (outcome-not-frequency —
charted per-play pressure is NULL in nflverse); proxy_rate = pressures/db;
trail4_proxy = trailing-4-week rate (the pass-rush rank input for the
pressure-answer adaptation, buildable-systems.md #24). n_teams_charted flags
partial weeks (bye weeks are normal; 0 true gaps vs the schedule).

## Honest gaps (None in the provider, never zero)

motion_rate, play_action_rate, rpo_rate, ttt_seconds, blitz_rate,
man_coverage_rate, two_high_rate — charting-gapped (DATA_GAPS.md). NGS
time-to-throw is internal-only per doctrine and is not in these tables.
